Welcome
This site documents my solutions, exercises, and key concepts from the R Programming interactive course in swirl.

title: R Programming: Swirl Notes
text:
Purpose of this Notebook

Track Progress: Document each lesson in the 15-module introductory R curriculum.
Reference Guide: Maintain a searchable collection of R syntax, base functions, and code examples.
Executable Notes: Test and preserve reproducible code chunks alongside personal takeaways.

title: R Programming: Swirl Notes
text:
Course Structure
The course is divided into three core sections:

Core Fundamentals: Basic syntax, workspace commands, sequences, vectors, and handling missing data (NA).
Data Structures & Logic: Matrices, data frames, logical tests, and writing custom functions.
Apply Family & Analysis: Functional programming (lapply, sapply, vapply, tapply), simulations, dates, and base graphics.
